complete_reachable_proof: Production platformStorageModule binds IosSnapshotFileSystem into singleton FileBackedSnapshotStore. App.kt120-143 runs loadHomeRecoveryAvailability on Home; readLocalRecoveryInventory50 then listUnfinished120 invoke filesystem.list152-171, which eagerly calls readProtectedOrMigrate169. Direct load75/loadMetadata93 and Retry reach the same implementation. No save opening or explicit Discard is needed to trigger the old purge.

A retained old/current pair is legitimate across interruption after atomically writing current369 and before deleting old214, or a post-write backupExcluder373 failure. If current has the seven-byte PARSNAP prefix plus its two header bytes but invalid version/truncation, decrypt280-290 throws before any Keychain call. Old try/finally still deleted legacy. The independent dossier establishes this earlier intentional policy separately from original ST-C1 backup eligibility.

New readProtectedOrMigrate175 first excludes/rechecks the legacy directory. Existing current bytes always take precedence: no current -> migrateLegacy, recognized current -> decrypt, plaintext-in-current -> one-way encrypted migration, other damaged bytes -> error. No authentication failure, absent key, key-read exception, or CancellationException selects legacy as input.

New186-188 computes successful decrypted plaintext before deleteLegacy. Any failure from decrypt exits before deletion; the bytes in both records remain. decrypt324-329 preserves the exact CancellationException or wraps ordinary crypto/key errors as before. The changed code adds no catch/fallback/empty-result path and changes no cryptography.

If decryption succeeds, deleteLegacy still runs; if that unlink fails, deletePathIfPresent250-251 still throws and current bytes are not overwritten. Explicit discard stays delete current then legacy143-149 and the shared store maps errors without exposing sensitive paths. Successful legacy migration retains writeProtected(encrypt(...)) before deletion208-215.

Common store mutex still serializes list/load/save/delete. Ordinary per-record migration errors remain discoverable; structural cancellation is rethrown. Retaining an excluded legacy sibling never authorizes stale recovery. A cancellation observed only after synchronous successful decryption/unlink still leaves the authenticated current copy intact; no new asynchronous checkpoint or authority handoff is introduced.

counter_evidence_considered: The pre-existing purge was intentional in historical d54ab0c and original ST-C1 explicitly treated it as different behavior. Retention is required by current scoped authorization; old audit claims remain unchanged.

Retaining plaintext without backup exclusion would revive original privacy issue. Exclusion still executes before list and every read/migration, with fresh Foundation readback, fail-closed failures and native regression coverage.

Falling back to legacy on missing/wrong key would bypass current precedence and risk stale/private-state recovery. No fallback is introduced; distinct-current-versus-stale-legacy success control and failure controls enforce this.
Successful decryption must still be allowed to remove obsolete legacy, and explicit Discard must remove both. Both remain executable assertions rather than inferred from names.
Cancelling read must not become CorruptedData or trigger old deletion in finally. Production catch ordering is unchanged and same-object cancellation native assertion passes.

Post-decrypt delete failure must not be swallowed. The delete helper and store failure mapping are unchanged; no exception-catching was added. No native injected-unlink-failure test was run in these cycles.

Passing toy JSON does not demonstrate last valid saved-state preservation. New data originates from real validated game state/envelope, with exact byte/decode assertions; native red failures establish the original loss.

Green names alone might hide undiscovered tests. Source-declared14+6 tests match all20 unique XML native records, and target log is actual iosSimulatorArm64Test without FROM-CACHE/UP-TO-DATE/NO-SOURCE on that test task.
